ability.name: Step 0 — Machine context check & AV/EDR Enumeration
ability.description: Examine native configuration, user privileges, domain membership, and current security agent footprints safely.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $id = whoami /all; $priv = whoami /priv; $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { "ADAPTER: $($_.InterfaceAlias)  IP: $($_.IPAddress)  PREFIX: $($_.PrefixLength)" }; $av = Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\SecurityCenter2 -Class AntiVirusProduct -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $av_list = if ($av) { $av | ForEach-Object { $_.displayName } } else { @() }; $rtp = Get-MpComputerStatus -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($rtp) { $av_list += "Windows Defender (RTP: $($rtp.RealTimeProtectionEnabled))" }; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; Write-Output "AV_EDR: $($av_list -join ', ')"; $adapters | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_ALL ---"; $id; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_PRIV ---"; $priv } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step0.txt

rationale: Initial landing verification of machine status, current privileges, and target endpoint protection systems.
